'''Luthos Garral''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and a garrison [[Commander/Legends|commander]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Garral genetically engineered the [[Garral/Legends|garral]], a type of canine pack hunter, by crossing the genes of a [[Mantessan panthac]] with those of several other creatures.
